Method of Attack: Vulnerability in API allowing authors on a site to manipulate any files in the WordPress installation
Discoverer: Automattic Developer Relations Engineer Jeremy Herve
Attack Vector: Exploitation of API vulnerability in Jetpack plugin
Indicators of Compromise: More than 4,130,000 sites using every version of Jetpack since 2.0 affected
Date of Discovery: Not explicitly stated, but vulnerability present since Jetpack version 2.0 (2012) and discovered during internal audit prior to patch release
